system.cloningHelp: Lets workspaces create a voice from a recording of a real person, who must have agreed to it; {brand} keeps who confirmed that and when. Turning this off stops new clones, but existing ones keep working.

system.impersonationEmailsHelp: When a server admin uses Sign in as …, the user gets one email at the start: which admin, the reason they gave, the time (UTC) and the workspace. Off by default. Every sign-in as a user is in the audit log either way.

system.zapierHelp: The Linedesk app on Zapier works with every Linedesk server, also this one: nothing to set up here. Each workspace connects it with its own API key and this server's address.
system.zapierSteps: Workspaces find <app>Linedesk on Zapier</app> and the steps in <link>Integrations › Zapier</link>. Your firewall must let Zapier reach this address and let the server send to {host}.
system.zapierUnreachable: {address}: Zapier can't reach it. Serve Linedesk on an https address on the internet.

tryOut.help.stt: Transcribes a short sample recording and checks the result against what was said.
